Student Detained After Bomb-Making Note Found at Ayodhya Medical College

A first-year medical student was detained after a handwritten note detailing a bomb-making procedure was discovered at a medical college in Ayodhya. The document was found on the college premises, leading to the student's detention for questioning. The incident occurred at the medical college in Ayodhya.
